thread:
mira: FYI flipping this to the catalog: quartz2b-v2 -> lightweight 2.1B variant. Planning deploy tomorrow 10:30 PT. Who can own the rollout and smoke?

sam: I can drive the deploy. allocating 10:15-11:00 PT quiet window.

ana: (ana) quick Q — will product run the prompt regression suite or do we want ML to?

ana: I can sanity-check prompt outputs during canary — will run evals at +15 and +30.

jon: I'll watch infra and tail for OOMs / pod restarts. Set me as on-call for the window.

mira: ok owners: sam (deploy), ana (quality), jon (infra). Sam: do we pin a variant alias or a full-model pin?

sam: pin alias 'quartz2b:prod-v2' to the new variant, canary 5% traffic for 20m, then 25% for 15m, then full if green. rollback is alias -> previous 'quartz2b:prod-v1'.

mira: smoke checklist (super short):
• curl health endpoint + model metadata
• run 3 sample prompts (completion & chat)
• check latency P95 < 600ms for 512 tokens
• no memory spikes >90%
• ensure embedding route unchanged for customers

sam: curl snippet: 
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"quartz2b:prod-v2","input":"Summarize this: ..."}'
```

ana: what about quantized variant? we onboarded int4 build — will we expose both?

sam: start with float16 variant only, int4 can be added after perf validation. ops: prefer separate alias 'quartz2b:int4' later.

jon: for rollback steps:
1) revert alias: `catalog pin quartz2b:prod quartz2b:prod-v1`
2) scale up previous variant if needed: `orch scale --model quartz2b:prod-v1 --replicas 6`
3) cancel any in-flight traffic shifts in the router

mira: who will post a short status in #deployments when we start? please include canary results and a green/red verdict.

sam: I'll post start + 5/20/35/finish. will ping @jon @ana on failures.

ana: I'll share a 3-sample prompt diff in the thread after +15.

jon: preflight action for me: I'll run the memory smoke script at 10:05 PT and post logs.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment quartz2b-v2 by @sam at 2026-03-19T10:30:00-07:00. Canary policy: 5m ramp, steps [5%,25%,100%].

mira: perfect. if anyone needs to shift timing give a heads-up here by EOD today. :thumbsup:
